pulls.title: Actor Chain Profile Support
pulls.author: mcguinness
pulls.body:
I think there in an opportunity to address a large interop gap with this spec with actor chains

See https://notes.karlmcguinness.com/notes/standardize-act-across-assertion-grants-and-jwt-access-tokens/ for description of the problem.

I don't think optimizing for a single-hop delegation is the right play for a new spec like this.  Addressing the large gap with delegation chains would drive urgency for adoption as folks don't have prior art.  

I don't expect this PR to be merged as-is, but rather start a discussion with something concrete that we can react to.   Happy to discuss more if you are interested.

pulls.title: Add Actor Profiles and delegation chain support in draft-01
pulls.author: Sreyanth
pulls.body:
Changes introduced in draft-01:

- Introduced Actor Profiles to classify acting entities in delegation contexts
- Extended Entity Profile use to JWT authorization grant assertions
- Added Karl McGuinness as co-author
- Clarified DCR behavior when the AS modifies or omits a requested client_profile
- Refined RS behavior to condition enforcement on entity_profiles_supported advertisement
- Editorial refinements to definitions and examples

This is a follow-up after reviewing #1 and the latest draft from Karl (https://mcguinness.github.io/draft-mcguinness-oauth-actor-profile/draft-mcguinness-oauth-actor-profile.html) to absorb the vocabulary layer for Actor Profiles into the Entity Profiles draft.
